payload.title: Gate and review of h-hold-2 (29f27cb)
payload.body:
Gate of h-hold-2, commit 29f27cbb4f0896871f88f618fb2f8b1951c784ec, aims G-5W1F5S#1-#6 and R-KKRB2S#1. Rubric, read from logs in .tree/evidence/<E>/:
(1) Tests on the commit: the 13 tests of E-Z4TQ38 rubric (1), whose base runs are pinned in E-Z4TQ38/new-tests-base.log (9 red, 4 green on afe2c1f), and the new TestLinkSupersedesHeldLikeSupersede (#3 under answer R-99GH9F#r1, R-KKRB2S#1), red on the superseded commit 33f18e0 before this add. All 14 must be green on the commit.
(2) Removal checks, each a patch on a clean checkout of the commit that must apply whole (else a failed removal); the named test must then fail: R1 to R7 as in E-Z4TQ38, with R2 now dropping the admitSupersede call in cmdSupersede; R8 drops the supersedes admit in cmdLink -> TestLinkSupersedesHeldLikeSupersede.
(3) go vet ./... and go test ./... -count=1 pass on the commit.
(4) Review: a fresh subagent reviews git show 29f27cbb4f0896871f88f618fb2f8b1951c784ec against the Goal lines and body and the owner's answer to R-99GH9F#r1, and returns each finding as a test with its output on the commit, labelled with its line or none. A returned test that is a case of a line and red on the commit contradicts h-hold-2.
supports: (1)-(4) hold. contradicts: a (1) test red on the commit, a removal that applies and leaves its test green, a gate failure, or a red review test of a line. inconclusive: only red findings whose line is in doubt.

why: OWED owes test h-hold-2; the repository keeps no gate recipe, so the body states the gate as its rubric.

payload.observation: Gate of 29f27cb: go vet and go test ./... pass; all 14 rubric tests are green on the commit; TestLinkSupersedesHeldLikeSupersede is red on 33f18e0; all 8 removal checks apply whole and their tests fail. Review: no defect; its two returned tests, labelled none, are green on the commit.

why: Gate and review of h-hold-2 ran.
